verses.text: Beside the rivers of Babylon, we sat down and cried when we remembered Zion.
We hung up our harps on the willow trees there.
Those who had taken us captive asked us to sing. Those who tormented us demanded happy songs. They said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"
How can we sing the songs of the LORD in a foreign land?
Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand forget how to play.
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not love Jerusalem more than my greatest joy.
LORD, remember what the people of Edom did on the day Jerusalem fell. They said, "Tear it down! Tear it down to its foundations!"
People of Babylon, you will be destroyed. Happy is the one who pays you back for what you have done to us.
Happy is the one who grabs your babies and smashes them against the rocks.
